capabilities: Apply Typora GitHub-theme typography and reading-view styling
Bundle Open Sans fonts with 16px body and matching heading sizes
Center content with selectable maximum widths of 860, 1024 or 1200px
Show the core Outline pane on the right via a command
Style paragraphs, lists, headings, tables and blockquotes in reading view
disambiguation: It does not launch Typora or open notes in it; it only applies Typora-like styling inside Obsidian.
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via community search pending approval, with manual GitHub-release install described. Visually tested only on macOS with Obsidian 1.13.7; Windows and Linux untested. The Outline core plugin must be enabled for the outline command, and reading view gives the closest result.
problem: Obsidian's default typography and reading layout do not look like Typora's centered GitHub-theme presentation, and the Outline pane is not styled or placed to match.

relations.evidence: applies typography and reading layout inspired by Typora's GitHub theme

summary: CSS-styling plugin that applies Typora GitHub-theme typography and centered reading layout, with an optional right-side Outline pane.
